activity.editor.accent_stripes_helper: Show the 4px coloured stripe at the left of each row indicating event type
activity.editor.filter_child_helper: Only show activity for this child

activity.editor.show_filter_chips_helper: Show the All / Chores / Rewards / Adjustments chip bar below the header

approvals.editor.child_id_helper: Filter approvals to a specific child
approvals.editor.child_id_placeholder: Leave empty to show all children
bonuses.editor.manage_note: Add, edit, and delete bonus templates directly on the card itself — tap the pencil icon in the card header. This editor only controls the card's appearance.
calendar.editor.child_helper: Show the calendar for a specific child only
calendar.editor.title: Title
child.editor.child_helper: Which child is this card for?
child.editor.dependency_helper: What to show when a chore depends on another that isn't approved yet today
child.editor.due_days_helper: Applies to chores with due_days set when today isn't scheduled
child.editor.first_come_dim: Dim — show greyed out for everyone except the child who completed it

child.editor.first_come_hide: Hide — remove once claimed (default, matches prior behavior)
child.editor.first_come_show: Show — keep fully visible for everyone (still not tappable once claimed)
child.editor.elapsed_helper: What to show when a morning/afternoon/evening/night chore wasn't completed and that time has passed
child.editor.recurrence_helper: What to show when a recurring chore has been completed and the window hasn't reset yet
child.editor.recurrence_hide: Hide — don't show until available again
child.editor.time_category_helper: Which time of day to show chores for — also sets the card title
common.editor.show_adults_helper: Include adult profiles on this card
common.editor.show_parent_actions_helper: Turn off on a shared kids' dashboard to show this card exactly as a child sees it, even while a parent is signed in. Display only — permissions are unchanged.
dashboard.editor.quick_points_helper: How many points the +/- buttons add or remove
graph.editor.child_filter_helper: Show one child's line or all children together
penalties.editor.manage_note: Add, edit, and delete penalty templates directly on the card itself — tap the pencil icon in the card header. This editor only controls the card's appearance.
points_card.editor.show_dialog_label: Show ⋯ button for custom amount with reason
points_display.editor.child_id_note: Save the entity first so children load automatically.
reorder.editor.child_helper: Which child to manage chore order for
reward_progress.editor.reward_helper: Which reward to show progress for
rewards.editor.enable_pool_mode_helper: Each reward becomes a dedicated savings pool — children allocate points directly to a goal rather than spending from a global balance
rewards.editor.expand_to_fit: Expand card to fit all rewards
rewards.editor.expand_to_fit_helper: Grow the card to show every reward instead of scrolling a fixed-height list (designed styles only)
rewards.editor.filter_by_child_helper: Only show rewards available to this child (leave empty for all rewards)
rewards.editor.show_child_badges_helper: Display which children can claim each reward
rewards.editor.title: Title
rewards.editor.title_helper: Card title displayed in the header (default: "Rewards")
streak.editor.child_helper: Show streak for a specific child only
streak.editor.days_shown_helper: How many days of dots to show (default: 14)
streak.editor.title: Title
sticker_chart.editor.goal_helper: This week's jobs: the blocks fill with the stars earned since Monday, out of every star the week's jobs can give. The reward and claim button stay as they are.
sticker_chart.editor.title: Title
sticker_chart.editor.reward_helper: The reward's cost becomes the goal. Leave on automatic to aim at the cheapest one they haven't earned yet.
sticker_chart.editor.show_today_helper: Show the "Today: x / y jobs done" line above the stickers.
sticker_chart.editor.allow_undo: Hold a sticker to undo it
sticker_chart.editor.allow_undo_helper: Press and hold a sticker to take it back. TaskMate only lets a parent do this.
sticker_chart.editor.show_claim_helper: A button under the goal that claims the reward once enough is earned (tap twice to confirm).
sticker_chart.editor.title_helper: Leave empty to use each child's name.
weekly.editor.child_helper: Show weekly summary for a specific child only
weekly.editor.title: Title
gallery.editor.entity_helper: The TaskMate activity sensor — the photos come from its history
gallery.editor.max_helper: Leave blank to show every photo
gallery.editor.title_helper: Leave blank for the default title
family_goal.editor.title_helper: Leave blank to show the goal's name
bounty.editor.child_helper: Whose bounty board this is — they see the bounties they can claim
auction.editor.child_helper: Whose auctions and bids this card shows
routine.editor.child_helper: Whose routine this card walks through, one task at a time.
routine.editor.time_category_helper: Which chores make up the routine: only chores set to this time of day. Whole day takes every chore due today.
kiosk.editor.title: Title
kiosk.editor.title_helper: Shown in the top bar, e.g. your family name
kiosk.editor.warn_before_return_helper: Full-screen “Still there?” countdown for the last 10 seconds
kiosk.editor.show_bounties_helper: Let each child claim and finish bounties here, with a photo from the tablet when one is asked for
kiosk.editor.show_rewards_helper: Let each child spend their points on a reward here. Every claim still needs a grown-up to approve it

kiosk.editor.completed_hide: Hide — once done or waiting for a grown-up

kiosk.editor.missed_show: Show — can still be ticked off
kiosk.editor.missed_dim: Dim — greyed out, can't be ticked off
kiosk.editor.play_sounds_helper: Each chore's completion sound, and the undo sound
kiosk.editor.show_completion_popup_helpe: A short “Awesome!” with the points after each chore
kiosk.editor.children_hint: Untick a child to hide them. Use the arrows to set the order on the picker.
kiosk.editor.no_pin: No PIN set — goes straight in
kiosk.editor.pin_note: PINs are set by a parent in the TaskMate panel → Children (stored hashed, never in the card's YAML).
child.editor.pre_reader_points: Show point values instead of stars in picture mode
child.editor.include_anytime_chores_help: Anytime chores normally appear under every time category — turn this off to hide them
recap.editor.default_frequency_helper: Which recap to open when there's nothing new
recap.editor.autoplay_helper: Move to the next slide every few seconds. Off: children tap at their own pace.
chore_board.editor.children_helper: Leave empty to show every child. Pick one child for a simple list.
chore_board.editor.tap_to_complete: Tap a chore to complete it
chore_board.editor.tap_to_complete_helpe: Turn off for a view-only board
chore_board.editor.hide_done_periods_hel: Drop a time of day once every child has finished its chores
raffle.editor.child_helper: The child who buys tickets on this card. Leave on Everyone for a wall tablet.
kiosk.editor.ambient_photos: Show a slideshow of chore photos
bests.editor.title: Title

kiosk.editor.show_boost_alert: Fill the screen when a boost starts

child.editor.seasonal_helper: Dress the card for Halloween, Christmas or summer when that theme is on in TaskMate settings.
heatmap.editor.title: Title
pet.editor.hide_unaffordable: Hide items the child can't afford yet
trophy.editor.title: Cabinet name
trophy.editor.children_helper: Leave empty for every child (grown-up profiles are left out)
trophy.editor.per_shelf_helper: A longer shelf shows this many, then a tile that opens the rest
trophy.editor.new_days: Mark as New for this many days
child.editor.show_tour_helper: A short walkthrough of this card, once per child. Turn the tour on or off for everyone in TaskMate Settings.
child.editor.sort_available_first_helper: Chores the child can do now go to the top. Chores for later today, missed ones and finished ones move further down.
